verdicts.evidence: src/Scans/sibling_link.jl:1-6 now says a later mention 'does not link the site again, though it may deep-link a named page' (matches code: sibling_link_hits! keeps scanning after the first hit and only flags a later match against `home_re`, a link ending exactly at `site`). But the function's own preceding comment at lines 19-21, inside the exact 17-30 range this finding cited, still says flatly 'every later line naming it must NOT' carry the mention inside a link — false, since a deep link (matching `link_re` but not `home_re`) is permitted and produces no hit. The class this finding names — a comment overstating what SCAN.SIBLING_LINK enforces — is fixed at the file header and in policy/docs-rubric.md:186-192 (which correctly states the deep-link exception) but survives verbatim in the docstring immediately above sibling_link_hits!.
